record.paper_title: New results and open questions for SIR-PH epidemic models with linear birth rate, loss of immunity, vaccination, and disease and vaccination fatalities
record.context_brief: Possible stable periodic solutions outside known SEIRS global-stability regimes
record.original_question: For the vaccinated varying-population SEIRS/SAIRS model in which existing theorems prove global stability of a unique endemic point only under certain parameter restrictions, can stable periodic solutions occur outside those proven global-stability cases?

evidence.quote:
[48, Thm 2.1] establishes global stability of a unique endemic point, in certain cases, and
suggest that outside those cases, "there may exist stable periodic solutions".

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a varying-population SEIRS/SAIRS compartmental epidemic model with vaccination, where the population is partitioned into Susceptible (S), Exposed/Asymptomatic (E or A), Infectious (I), and Recovered (R) compartments, governed by the system of ODEs

  S' = Λ − μ S − β S I / N − ν S + γ R,
  E' = β S I / N − (μ + σ) E,
  I' = σ E − (μ + α + δ) I,
  R' = δ I + ν S − (μ + γ) R,

with N = S + E + I + R, all parameters Λ, μ, β, ν, γ, σ, α, δ > 0, and where vaccination moves susceptibles directly to R at rate ν and immunity is lost at rate γ. Suppose that global asymptotic stability of the unique endemic equilibrium (when the basic reproduction number R₀ > 1) has been proved only under a restricted set of parameter conditions. 

Question: Outside those known parameter regimes in which the endemic equilibrium is proved globally asymptotically stable, do there exist parameter values for which the system admits a stable periodic (limit-cycle) solution? Equivalently, does the model exhibit Hopf bifurcation leading to attracting periodic orbits in some region of parameter space?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted search did not locate a definitive proof or disproof of the existence of stable periodic solutions for vaccinated varying-population SEIRS/SAIRS models in the regimes outside the known global-stability conditions. Related literature on SAIRS and SEIRS models with vaccination indicates this remains a conjectural/open direction.

status_evidence.title: SIR-PH epidemic models survey
status_evidence.snippet: Suggests that outside the proven global-stability cases there may exist stable periodic solutions.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of stable periodic solutions outside known global-stability regimes is posed as an open question.
